evidence_scope: validation (selection) results; the sealed test window [2025-11-01, 2026-11-01) is never read
note: Re-read from already-computed validation runs; no new simulation. The registered scenario is the registered result; the others are scenario estimates (one-axis sensitivities, D-058), never pooled with it.

definitions.remote_execution: the job executed at a site other than Utah (PACE); remote execution energy is that job's execution energy at the destination
definitions.moved: ledger `moved`: the job did not run on its booking, so it includes remote execution, retiming at home and rigid jobs' home queue slips (F08); on the execution basis moved = remote + retimed + rigid slips
definitions.remote_energy_share: remote jobs' energy (execution plus transfer) / all energy (execution plus transfer), copied from the scored run
definitions.remote_execution_share: remote execution kWh / all execution kWh, from the ledger
definitions.retimed_home_execution_share: execution kWh of flexible jobs that ran in Utah off their booking start / all execution kWh, from the ledger
definitions.rigid_slip_execution_share: execution kWh of non-flexible jobs whose Utah start moved off their booking (queue slips, not a router choice) / all execution kWh
definitions.week_arcs: cohort jobs arriving in the replay week that executed at each destination: count and declared GPU-hours (gpus x declared duration)
definitions.saving_vs_U: copied verbatim from metrics.json (registered) or extensions.json (scenarios): (U - policy) / U, ratio of totals, 4-week blocks, 95% interval; not recomputed
